gpt-4o-mini.title: The Call of the Wild (Library of America)
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A gripping adventure by Jack London, this classic novel follows a domesticated dog named Buck as he is thrust into the brutal wilderness of the Yukon during the Gold Rush, exploring themes of survival and the primal instincts of nature.

gpt-4o-mini.title: White Fang
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A gripping adventure by Jack London, this novel follows the life of a wild wolfdog navigating the challenges of survival and the struggle between nature and civilization. Themes of loyalty, instinct, and the harsh realities of life in the wilderness are vividly explored.

gpt-4o-mini.title: Martin Eden
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: In Jack London's "Martin Eden," a struggling writer's relentless pursuit of success and love leads him to confront the harsh realities of ambition and societal expectations. This powerful novel explores themes of individuality, class struggle, and the cost of self-discovery.

gemma2:9b.explanation: A gripping adventure by Jack London, this novel follows a domesticated dog named Buck as he is thrust into the brutal wilderness of the Yukon during the Gold Rush, exploring themes of survival and instinct.

gemma2:9b.explanation: In Jack London's "Martin Eden" (French Edition), the story follows a struggling writer's relentless pursuit of success and the personal sacrifices he makes along the way, exploring themes of ambition, class struggle, and the quest for identity.
